videos.headline: Texas Tech's late layup completes incredible comeback in OT thriller
videos.description: Texas Tech's Darrion Williams drops in a clutch, go-ahead layup late in overtime as the Red Raiders hold on to complete the comeback vs. Arkansas.

tracking.trackingName: NCB_One-Play (Texas Tech's late layup completes incredible comeback in OT thriller) 2025/03/28 ESHEET

videos.headline: Highlight: Arkansas falls in overtime heartbreaker to Texas Tech in Sweet 16
videos.description: Despite leading by as many as 16 and getting 30 points from Johnell Davis, the Razorbacks fall short of an Elite Eight berth in an 85-83 loss to the Red Raiders.

videos.headline: Karter Knox hits deep 3 for Arkansas
videos.description: Arkansas' Karter Knox pulls up from way downtown and drains the 3-pointer in the first half.

tracking.trackingName: NCB_One-Play (Karter Knox hits deep 3 for Arkansas) 2025/03/28 ESHEET

videos.headline: Federiko Federiko catches lob for a Texas Tech jam
videos.description: Texas Tech's Elijah Hawkins tosses it up to Federiko Federiko for a two-handed jam in the first half.

tracking.trackingName: NCB_One-Play (Federiko Federiko catches lob for a Texas Tech jam) 2025/03/28 ESHEET

videos.headline: Karter Knox flies in for an Arkansas jam
videos.description: Arkansas' Karter Knox drives straight to the rack for a two-handed dunk in the second half.

tracking.trackingName: NCB_One-Play (Karter Knox flies in for an Arkansas jam) 2025/03/28 ESHEET

videos.headline: Stephen A. calls out Calipari for not calling timeout in Arkansas' OT loss
videos.description: Stephen A. Smith says Arkansas deserves credit for reaching the Sweet 16, but questions John Calipari's coaching decisions in crunch time.
